details.description: SSD-1B (Segmind Stable Diffusion 1B) is a text-to-image diffusion model from Segmind, distilled to about 50% the size of Stability AI's SDXL base model while offering a 60% speedup, per the model card. It was trained through knowledge distillation from several expert models in succession -- SDXL, ZavyChromaXL, and JuggernautXL -- on diverse datasets including Grit and Midjourney-scrape data, and is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
advantages: Segmind reports up to a 60% inference speedup versus the base SDXL model, measured on A100 80GB and RTX 4090 GPUs, per the model card.
About 50% smaller than SDXL (1B parameters) while distilling knowledge from multiple expert models (SDXL, ZavyChromaXL, and JuggernautXL), per the model card.
Supports nine output resolutions/aspect ratios, from 640x1536 up to 1536x640, alongside a 1024x1024 square default, per the model card.
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, per the model card.
disadvantages: The model card states it has challenges achieving photorealism, especially in human depictions.
The model card states it struggles with rendering clear text and maintaining fidelity in complex compositions.
The model card recommends negative prompting and a CFG scale around 9.0 for best quality, suggesting default settings may need tuning.
use_cases: Art and design: generating artworks, designs, and other creative visual content
Educational tools that need illustrative visual content
Research into generative text-to-image models and their limitations/biases
Further fine-tuning (e.g. LoRA) on top of the base model for custom styles, per the model card

notes: No accuracy-style benchmark scores were found on the model card, only a speed comparison to base SDXL, which is excluded from evaluations per the instructions (speed is not an accuracy score) and reported as an advantage instead with attribution. No deprecation or legacy notice was found on the model card; the paper is dated 2024 and the card does not mention any newer Segmind successor superseding it.
